name: meisijiya-phase-checkpoint
description: Agent-driven phase boundary notification — soft-prompt user with 'Phase N 完成,要 /handoff 吗?还是继续?' when .omo/plans/<slug>.md current phase acceptance criteria all checked. NOT for mid-phase work, NOT for writing handoff doc (that's meisijiya-handoff), NOT for forcing split.

positive_triggers.input: Phase 3 的 slice 1-5 全部完成,acceptance criteria 都勾选了
positive_triggers.reason: Phase 整体完成 → 触发 soft-prompt(三选一)。注意: '全部完成' 也是 completion claim,会触发 verification-before-completion;最终路由到 phase-checkpoint 是因 SKILL.md omo Integration 双 skill 仲裁(verification gate 优先,gate 通过后 phase-checkpoint emit 通知)

positive_triggers.input: 我刚把 Phase 4 verification 的 7 个 checkbox 都勾了,verification 看起来过了
positive_triggers.reason: Phase 4 整体完成 → soft-prompt;user 选 /handoff 切 session 或选 继续 进 Phase 7。同上,verification-before-completion 也会 match,最终 phase-checkpoint(verify gate 后)是正确的 final routing

positive_triggers.input: Phase 1 spec 已经 attestation 了(.omo/plans/<slug>.md Phase 1 段全 [x])
positive_triggers.reason: Phase 1 完成 → soft-prompt,user 决定 /handoff 跨 session 推进 Phase 3 还是继续

negative_triggers.input: 我刚完成 Phase 3 slice 3,继续 slice 4
negative_triggers.reason: mid-phase(Phase 3 内 sub-task),phase 整体 acceptance criteria 未全勾,不打扰

negative_triggers.input: 我想 /handoff 一下,从 Phase 3 到 Phase 4
negative_triggers.reason: user 主动触发 handoff 写 doc → 走 handoff skill 而非 phase-checkpoint(handoff 是契约层,user-driven)
无 plan → 静默跳过(per Process §1);user 应走 brainstorming 先建 Phase 0 Design

negative_triggers.input: Phase 0 design brainstorm 一下 auth 重构的方案
negative_triggers.reason: Phase 0 Design 阶段由 brainstorming HARD-GATE 管,不是 phase-completion 通知

negative_triggers.input: All Phase 0 design decisions approved and documented, time to move forward
negative_triggers.reason: Phase 0 是 approval-based phase(无 - [ ] 结构),NOT-for L34 + Process §3 L58 排除;phase-vocabulary.md §2 — Phase 0 是 brainstorming 自己的 gate,phase-checkpoint 不二次通知

negative_triggers.input: 我刚改完 Phase 3 的第一个 slice 的代码
negative_triggers.reason: mid-iteration 工作,phase 整体 acceptance criteria 未勾,phase-checkpoint 不触发

behavioral_evals.scenario: Agent 检测到 Phase 3 acceptance criteria 全勾选,emit 三选一 prompt
expected_behavior: Agent reads .omo/plans/<slug>.md Phase 3 section,确认所有 - [x]
Agent optionally checks git log -n 5 for Phase 4 prep commits(soft signal,不是 hard gate)
Agent emits verbatim 三选一: /handoff / 继续 / 走 notepad
Agent does NOT write handoff doc, does NOT modify plan
Agent waits for user decision; does NOT proceed automatically

behavioral_evals.scenario: User 在 prompt 后选 2(继续),agent 进入 Phase 4 后又完成一些 sub-task
expected_behavior: Agent does NOT re-prompt during Phase 4 work
Phase 4 整体 acceptance criteria 全勾后才再触发一次 prompt

behavioral_evals.scenario: User 同时表达 'Phase 3 完成了,帮我 handoff 一下' — 两 skill 同时 match
expected_behavior: Agent recognises both phase-checkpoint (phase completion) and handoff (handoff request) triggers
Agent routes to handoff skill as primary(handoff 是 user-driven 契约层),not phase-checkpoint
Agent does NOT first run phase-checkpoint 判定 then handoff — directly handoff skill

behavioral_evals.scenario: phase 段无 - [ ] 结构(Phase 3 ticket DAG 形式)
expected_behavior: Agent skips the phase automatically, does NOT prompt
Agent does NOT count ticket checkboxes as acceptance criteria

behavioral_evals.scenario: User 选 3(走 notepad)后,agent 应该 append-only 写 1 行到 decisions.md
expected_behavior: Agent writes single line: '## Phase <N> → notepad @ <ISO-8601> ...'
Agent does NOT write learnings, issues, or progress details to notepad
Agent confirms continuation in same session

notes: Agent-driven phase boundary notification. No disable-model-invocation (agent may invoke when phase completion detected). Complements meisijiya-handoff: this skill NOTIFIES, handoff skill WRITES (handoff skill keeps disable-model-invocation: true for user-triggered contract).
